name: mark
description: An item mark: a keyline, an optional glyph and a word, saying something about one item (Private, out of memory). Never colour alone, never a tint.

glyph.description: The glyph before the word. "lock" in the designed screens; the walkthrough runtime adds marks with no glyph.

label.description: The word or short phrase, final copy ("Private, out of memory"). Set in caps by the CSS; write it in sentence case.

exposes.--aj-c-mark-display: Its display. Default inline-flex; an entry row with entry actions sets none, because the memory dropdown already says it.

states.focus-visible: n/a: not interactive and never focusable
states.loading: n/a: a mark states a fact about an item
states.empty: n/a: a mark with no word is not rendered

assets.name: lock glyph
assets.file: inline SVG in mark.html.mjs (24x24 viewBox, stroke currentColor, width 2)

a11y.role: none: an inline span of text
a11y.labels: the word is the content; the glyph is aria-hidden

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css D4 .mark. The entry row hides it through the exposed --aj-c-mark-display (a legacy display:none could not override the module).
